_README.description: Model metadata for Anthropic's Claude API (direct Messages API access).
_README.usage: Models listed here are exposed directly through the native Anthropic provider (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Aliases are case-insensitive. Claude models are also reachable via OpenRouter (anthropic/... IDs); when both an Anthropic key and OpenRouter are configured, the native Anthropic provider wins by priority so bare aliases like 'opus'/'fable' route direct.

field_descriptions.model_name: The Anthropic Messages API model identifier (e.g., 'claude-opus-5')
field_descriptions.aliases: Array of short names users can type instead of the full model name
field_descriptions.context_window: Total number of tokens the model can process (input + output combined)
field_descriptions.max_output_tokens: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a single response
field_descriptions.max_thinking_tokens: Maximum reasoning/thinking tokens when extended thinking is requested (Anthropic budget_tokens; clamped to >=1024 and < max_output_tokens at call time)
field_descriptions.supports_extended_thinking: Whether the model supports Anthropic extended thinking (reasoning) budgets
field_descriptions.supports_json_mode: Whether the model can guarantee valid JSON output
field_descriptions.supports_function_calling: Whether the model supports tool use
field_descriptions.supports_images: Whether the model can process image input
field_descriptions.max_image_size_mb: Maximum total size in MB for all images combined
field_descriptions.supports_temperature: Whether the model accepts a temperature parameter (forced to 1.0 by the API when extended thinking is enabled)
field_descriptions.temperature_constraint: Type of temperature constraint: 'fixed', 'range', 'discrete', or omit for default range
field_descriptions.default_reasoning_effort: Default reasoning effort level for models that support it
field_descriptions.intelligence_score: 1-20 human rating used as the primary signal for auto-mode model ordering. Anchored to the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3 as listed on 2026-09-11 (v4.2 and v4.3 rescaled the Index on 2026-09-04 and 2026-09-07); re-verified against v4.3.2 on 2026-09-24 with the reference scores unchanged.
field_descriptions.allow_code_generation: Whether this model can generate fully working code for your AI tool to use right away. Only true for a model more capable than the AI model / CLI you're currently using.
